entities.name: Boc-protected piperidine
observations: tert-Butyl (S)-piperidine-3-ylcarbamate contains a secondary piperidine nitrogen available for N-arylation.
The exocyclic amino group is protected as a Boc carbamate.

entities.name: Bromofluorobenzene
observations: Bromofluorobenzene provides an aryl C–Br bond for coupling while retaining the aryl C–F bond.
SNAr at C–F is unlikely without strong electron-withdrawing activation on the ring.

entities.name: Buchwald-Hartwig N-arylation
observations: The transformation replaces aryl C–Br with aryl C–N at the piperidine nitrogen.
Likely conditions use a palladium catalyst or precatalyst, bulky phosphine ligand, strong base, and an aprotic solvent under heat.

entities.name: Likely Buchwald conditions
observations: Plausible bases include NaOtBu, KOtBu, Cs2CO3, or K3PO4.
Plausible solvents include toluene, 1,4-dioxane, DMA, or DMF.
Plausible catalysts include Pd2(dba)3 or Pd(OAc)2 with BrettPhos, XPhos, BINAP, or a related bulky phosphine ligand.
